b5_uses: target own current value + all ten training-PCA factor scores; factor VAR rollout
b3_uses: full current population state; full lag-one VAR
interpretation: B5 and the evaluation metric use the same training-only ten-PC transform. B5 therefore retains all ten evaluation dimensions, but its residual-source operator has the restricted form diag(own_scale) @ Q, i.e. one own-row direction per output neuron. B3's residual-source rows are almost entirely outside that one-dimensional pattern. This proves B3 has access to cross-neuron residual information that B5 cannot represent; it does not prove that this access causes the observed score advantage.
unresolved: Separating residual-coordinate information from B3's much larger parameter count would require a prespecified restricted model or new data; no such model is fitted or selected on the reused test tails here.
